architectural_reference.title: 华表 — 故宫博物院
architectural_reference.use: Verified circular shaft with cloud carvings and ascending coiled dragon. No museum image pixels copied.

transform: Entire native generated square resized with Lanczos to1024; RGB WebPquality91. No recoloring, cropping, seam synthesis or animal redrawing.

uv_notes.u: Map0..1 once around circumference; left/right wrap requested and inspected in2x repeat preview. Model-generated edge continuity is not a mathematical periodicity guarantee; place join toward rear.
uv_notes.v: Map0..1 once along shaft for one ascending dragon; repeatT>1 duplicates the head. A3m circumference/4.5m shaft gives1.5x vertical stretch from square source.
uv_notes.lighting: Soft tiny carved-recess shading only; actual cylinder geometry and renderer supply volumetric lighting.
